Where Shopify funnels leak creative performance

Dense cards frame the operational problems ecommerce teams recognize immediately.

Ad-to-page mismatch

Paid social promises one angle, but the landing page and PDP visuals tell a different story.

Weak product imagery

SKU photos are technically correct but do not create desire, usage clarity or trust.

Slow A/B creative tests

Every hook, offer, background or badge change becomes another design ticket.

Brand drift across channels

PDP assets, ad creatives, emails and social posts slowly stop looking like the same brand.

Localization bottleneck

New markets need translated copy, local cues and size variants, but teams rebuild manually.

No post-launch loop

After launch, teams cannot quickly refresh winning creatives for remarketing or repeat purchase.
